Name: RRRR Immersive Children Portraits and Sprite Patch - Vanilla and Nyapu Included
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This was originally a small patch that would've only added a recoloured RRRR nyapu portrait but it expanded to include the Vanilla style portraits sprites and alternative nyapu style portraits to match the hairstyles from the RRRR children mod :)

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/173186797]shantoryuu[/url] for giving me the idea for this mod ^-^

I recommend you pair it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/125586323]AlmostMidnight[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23321]Nyapu RRRR Portrait mod[/url]﻿ OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142995153]Jupm[/url]'s Nyapu's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22928]Style Wizard for RRRR[/url]﻿ as they both include seasonal outfits!

If you want the full retexture of all children checkout my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27513]Nyapu Style for the 'Immersive Children'[/url]﻿ Mod!

Let me know if there's any bugs, or if you'd like me to add anything.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]
This is a replacer mod - meaning it replaces the original mod's pngs. Here's a step by step guide on how to use this mod:

[list=1]
[*]Install the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url]﻿' Mod
[*]Download and unzip this mod
[*]There are four folders - The baby sprites, toddler sprites, vanilla Portraits and Nyapu Style Portraits. Choose which sprites or portraits you'd like to use.
[*]Once you've chosen go into the '[CP] Immersive Children' mod and replace the original sprites and portraits of the Wizard character (or any other if you rename the png). For example You will have to rename your chosen portraits 'Magnus_Girl_W' if you are swapping the white portrait (Magnus_Girl_W.png) with the 'RRRR_Girl_W.png'.
[*]Currently the baby and toddler sprites are already named after the Magnus sprites so it's an easy process to override the original. You will need to go into the original mod and open the 'Babies' and 'Sprites' folders which will both show 'Boy' and 'Girl' folders. You can just drag and drop the 'Boy' and 'Girl' folders from this mod to replace the original Magnus Sprites.

[*]If you'd like to use the Pink Skin option instead of the three skin tones make sure to rename it so it can override the original images (since currently there isn't a 4th skin tone option to override you'll miss out on at least one skin tone).

[*]You're done!


[b]If you're using the Alternative Portraits:
[/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Download the Immersive Children Portaits Pack in the Optional Files instead


[*]Now just rename your chosen portraits to replace the Wizard portraits with the matching skintone. E.g. Rename a Darker Portrait 'RRRR_Girl_D2'.png to 'Magnus_Girl_D2' and replace the original portrait in the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412] Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites [/url]﻿mod.

[/list][list=1]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Works nicely with my other Nyapu Immersive Children Portraits - should work with any portrait mod though
